references.text: The children of Israel came to the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Kadesh. This is the same event where the people arrived at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Sin.
The spies returned to Moses, Aaron, and all the congregation of Israel at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Paran. Kadesh was an important gathering place for the Israelites.
Moses mentions the time from Kadesh-barnea until they crossed the Zered Brook. Kadesh-barnea is identical with Kadesh in the Wilderness of Sin.
The water at Meribah in Kadesh in the Wilderness of Sin, where Moses and Aaron were disobedient to the Lord. This confirms Kadesh's location in the Wilderness of Sin.
King Solomon built ships at Ezion-geber, which was located at Elath on the shore of the Red Sea in Edom. This is the same place as Ezion-geber mentioned in the verse.
Jehoshaphat built Tarshish ships to sail to Ophir for gold, but the ships were destroyed at Ezion-geber. Another reference to Ezion-geber as a harbor.
The Israelites stayed in Kadesh for a long time. This shows Kadesh's significance as a prolonged resting place during the wilderness journey.
